news.headline: HP Inc. Reports Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results and Announces Dividend Increase
news.summary: HP Inc. reported fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter revenue of $16.00 billion and announced an increase in its dividend.

news.headline: HPQ Silicon Secures First Conditional Purchase Reservation for ENDURA+ MiniMax Power Systems
news.summary: HPQ Silicon Inc. has signed its first conditional purchase reservation agreement for 100 units of its ENDURA+ MiniMax portable power systems, valued at approximately US$125,000.

news.headline: Citigroup and D.A. Davidson Adjust Price Targets on Autodesk
news.summary: Financial analysts at Citigroup and D.A. Davidson have updated their price targets for Autodesk, Inc. following the company's fiscal third-quarter earnings report.

news.headline: Deutsche Bank and Wells Fargo Maintain Buy Ratings Ahead of Autodesk Q3 Earnings
news.summary: Deutsche Bank and Wells Fargo have reaffirmed their 'Buy' ratings and $330 price targets for Autodesk as the company prepares to report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 results.

news.headline: Baird Adjusts Price Target on Bloom Energy to $263 From $351
news.summary: Baird has revised its price target for Bloom Energy Corporation, lowering it from $351 to $263.

news.headline: Lam Research Breaks Ground on New Taiwan Technology Center
news.summary: Lam Research has initiated construction on a new technology center in Zhunan, Miaoli County, Taiwan, aimed at expanding its research and development capabilities for AI chip manufacturing.

news.headline: Lam Research and University at Albany Announce Semiconductor Workforce Collaboration
news.summary: Lam Research Corporation and the University at Albany have partnered to provide engineering students with hands-on experience using virtual fabrication software to address the growing demand for skilled semiconductor talent.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Coherent Price Target to $300 From $420
news.summary: BNP Paribas has revised its price target for Coherent Corp. shares, lowering it from $420 to $300.

news.headline: Micron Discloses Increased Executive Security Expenses
news.summary: Micron Technology's latest proxy filing reveals a significant increase in security spending for CEO Sanjay Mehrotra.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Downgrades Micron Technology to Neutral
news.summary: BNP Paribas has downgraded Micron Technology, Inc. to a Neutral rating with a price target of $775.

news.headline: SanDisk Chief Accounting Officer Discloses Stock Sale in SEC Filing
news.summary: Michael Pokorny, Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer of SanDisk, sold 26,016 shares of company stock in a transaction reported on November 25, 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Sandisk to $218 From $218.75
news.summary: Morgan Stanley has slightly lowered its price target for Sandisk Corporation to $218 from the previous $218.75.

news.headline: UBS Adjusts Price Target on Applied Materials
news.summary: UBS has revised its price target for Applied Materials, lowering it from $640 to $575 while maintaining a Buy rating.

news.headline: David Tepper's Appaloosa Management Discloses New Position in Applied Materials
news.summary: Billionaire hedge fund manager David Tepper's firm, Appaloosa Management, has initiated a new $115 million investment position in semiconductor equipment manufacturer Applied Materials.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target for AMD
news.summary: BNP Paribas has revised its price target for Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) to $650, down from its previous target of $960.

news.headline: Bernstein Initiates Coverage on AMD with Buy Rating
news.summary: Bernstein analyst Mark Newman has initiated coverage on Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. with a "buy" rating and a price target of $650.

news.headline: TrendForce Reports Growing Demand for AMD Helios AI Server Systems
news.summary: Market research firm TrendForce reports increasing demand from cloud service providers for AMD's Helios AI server systems, while noting potential deployment and delivery challenges.

news.headline: Oracle Commodity Holding Corp. Restores 2% Royalty on Pulacayo-Paca Silver Project
news.summary: Oracle Commodity Holding Corp. announced the restoration of its 2% net smelter return royalty on the Pulacayo-Paca silver mining project in Bolivia following a court-ordered restatement of the project's Mining Production Contract.

news.headline: Oracle Confirms Full Funding for OpenAI Infrastructure Contract
news.summary: Oracle has publicly dismissed reports suggesting it lacks the necessary capital to fulfill its infrastructure contract with OpenAI, confirming it is fully funded for the current investment cycle.

news.headline: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Reportedly Apologizes to Staff and Enters Therapy
news.summary: Following his reinstatement as CEO, Jensen Huang has reportedly apologized to NVIDIA employees and disclosed that he is in therapy.

news.headline: NVIDIA Reinstates Jensen Huang as President and CEO
news.summary: NVIDIA's Board of Directors has unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

news.headline: NVIDIA Former CEO Jensen Huang Agrees to Senate Testimony
news.summary: Former NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly agreed to testify in public before the U.S. Senate regarding recent controversies.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Ciena Price Target
news.summary: BNP Paribas has revised its price target for Ciena Corporation, lowering it from $640 to $375.

news.headline: Corning Participates in Korea-US AI Cooperation Roundtable
news.summary: Representatives from Corning joined a closed-door roundtable hosted by the American Chamber of Commerce in Korea to discuss AI infrastructure and manufacturing.

news.headline: Citi Maintains Buy Rating and $200 Price Target for Corning
news.summary: Citi analyst Asiya Merchant maintained a Buy rating on Corning Incorporated and kept the price target at $200.

news.headline: Mizuho Adjusts Price Target on Corning to $145 From $180
news.summary: Mizuho Securities has lowered its price target for Corning Incorporated from $180 to $145 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

news.headline: Lumentum CEO Addresses Marvell Merger Status Amid Market Volatility
news.summary: Lumentum's CEO reaffirmed the strategic value of the proposed merger with Marvell, even as reports emerged regarding challenges to the company's merger defense.

news.headline: Oppenheimer and Fubon Adjust Price Targets for Marvell Technology
news.summary: Analysts at Oppenheimer and Fubon have updated their price targets for Marvell Technology, reflecting ongoing market volatility and sector-wide revaluations.

news.headline: RBC Capital Markets Projects Marvell Technology Fiscal Q3 Beat Driven by Optical Demand
news.summary: RBC analysts anticipate that strong demand for optical products will lead to a positive earnings surprise for Marvell Technology in its upcoming fiscal third-quarter results.

news.headline: Oppenheimer Adjusts Price Target on Marvell Technology to $325 From $425
news.summary: Oppenheimer has lowered its price target for Marvell Technology, Inc. from $425 to $325 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

news.headline: Teradyne Opens New 5,000 Square Meter Facility in Cebu, Philippines
news.summary: Teradyne has expanded its operational footprint by opening a new 5,000 square meter built-to-suit facility in Cebu, Philippines, managed by DHL Supply Chain.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target on Intel to $60 From $70
news.summary: BNP Paribas has revised its price target for Intel Corporation, lowering it from $70 to $60.

news.headline: Intel Announces Executive Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences
news.summary: Intel Corporation announced that company executives will participate in three investor conferences in December 2026 to discuss the company's business and strategy.

news.headline: Citi Maintains Buy Rating and $115 Price Target for Amphenol
news.summary: Citi analyst Asiya Merchant has reaffirmed a Buy rating and a $115 price target for Amphenol Corporation.

news.headline: Baird Adjusts Price Target on Amphenol to $90 From $105
news.summary: Baird has lowered its price target for Amphenol Corporation from $105 to $90.

news.headline: General Motors Korea to Adopt Tesla's North American Charging Standard
news.summary: General Motors' Korean division has signed an agreement with Tesla to implement the North American Charging Standard (NACS) for its electric vehicles in South Korea.

news.headline: European Union Postpones Approval Discussion for Tesla's Self-Driving Technology
news.summary: The European Union has delayed a scheduled meeting to discuss the approval of Tesla's Full Self-Driving (FSD) technology across the bloc until December 7.

news.headline: RBC Capital and Seaport Initiate Coverage of Tesla
news.summary: Analysts at RBC Capital and Seaport have initiated coverage of Tesla, both assigning the stock a 'Buy' rating.

news.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target on Seagate Technology
news.summary: BNP Paribas has revised its price target for Seagate Technology, lowering it from $1,275 to $835.

news.headline: Power Probe PLC Announces Director Share Purchase
news.summary: Power Probe PLC disclosed that Non-Executive Director Ip Foo Wing, through the Ojai Valley Trust, purchased 15,000 ordinary shares on November 23 and 24, 2026.

news.headline: Director Share Purchase Notification
news.summary: Non-Executive Director Ip Foo Wing purchased 10,000 ordinary shares in Power Probe plc via the Ojai Valley Trust.
